    "A2: gloves are worn on the hands. Omitted clean.",
    "A4: old dressing is no longer covering the burn. Omitted gently.",
    "A7: visible applied layer is present on the burn. Omitted cotton swab, thin, ointment identity.",

    "A9: gauze roll is wrapped around the burn. Omitted loosely.",
    "A10: medical tape is positioned on the gauze. Omitted medical tape identity. Burned skin contact is checked in procedure_error_criteria."
